items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser that clears the day without stripping, so skin looks fresher rather than tight.
Hyaluronic acid adds a light layer of hydration that suits oily skin and helps skin look plumper and less dull.
A lightweight ceramide moisturizer supports the skin barrier and softens the look of rough texture without feeling heavy.
A mineral SPF 50 protects skin from daily sun exposure and helps keep tone looking even and bright.

response.routine_note: Cleanse, apply hyaluronic serum and moisturizer, then finish with sunscreen in the morning, and repeat without sunscreen at night. I left out the 30% peel and other strong exfoliating or resurfacing products because they aren't a good fit during pregnancy, so please check with your prenatal provider before adding any active.
